title: A Lovely Letter
description: Sven and Faendal both vie for Camilla Valerius's affection in Riverwood. Each asks the player to deliver a forged letter to Camilla to sabotage the other's chances with her.

base_facts: I am a bard in Riverwood with feelings for Camilla Valerius.
Faendal is trying to come between me and Camilla.
I have a letter I would like someone to deliver to Camilla on my behalf.

HEAR_OF_RIVALRY: Someone knows about my rivalry with Faendal over Camilla.
AGREE_HELP_SVEN: Someone agreed to help me by delivering my letter to Camilla.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The matter with Camilla has been settled and I am grateful for the help.

base_facts: I run the Riverwood Trader with my brother Lucan.
Both Sven and Faendal are interested in me and their rivalry is tiresome.

beats.comment: Player learns about the love triangle between Sven, Faendal, and Camilla.
Player agrees to help Sven by delivering his fake letter to Camilla.
Player agrees to help Faendal by delivering his fake letter to Camilla.
Quest completed after delivering the letter and returning to the winner for the reward.
